title: Moxa NPort W2150A and W2250A
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW CREDENTIALS MANAGEMENT CWE-255 The default password is empty on the device. An unauthorized user can access the device without a password. An unauthorized user has the ability to completely compromise the confidentiality and integrity of the wireless traffic. CVE-2017-16727 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 6.5 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N ). RESEARCHER Federico Maggi reported the vulnerability to ICS-CERT. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Critical Manufacturing, Energy, and Transportation Systems Countries/Areas Deployed: Worldwide Company Headquarters Location: Taiwan This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
